newsitem.title: EGYPT: Alexandria iron, steel '96 profit up.
newsitem.headline: Alexandria iron, steel '96 profit up.

text.p: Alexandria National Iron and Steel (ANSDK) profit available for distribution rose in 1996 to 122.7 million pounds compared to 120.4 million in the previous year, a statement published in Al-Ahram newspaper on Friday said.
Total sales were 1.3 billion pounds in 1996 compared to 1.5 billion pounds the previous year, the statement said.

The company was among those named by the Egyptian government which the state intends to sell under its fast-moving privatisation programme. It expects to sell five percent of ANSDK, in which it holds 65 percent. -- Cairo newsroom +202 578 3290
